title: Builder: a presentation default for every role on all ten site themes
detail:
components/sites/presentation/*.ts sets 0 to 9 role defaults per theme today (Default 0, Free Human 5, Bold and Wildheart 6, Designer 7, Network 7, Temple 8, Nocturne 9). Give each theme a default variant for all 23 roles, chosen from that theme's design system, one file per theme, no new art. A layout an owner picked still wins. Done when: presentationDefault(theme, role) is defined for every theme and role pair and presentation.test.ts pins the table. 2026-11-03 progress: the five new roles (firstvisit, booking, locations, business, story) now have a default on all nine themed sites, pinned in presentation.test.ts. Still open: the older roles no theme sets yet; DAWN stays empty on purpose.

All 22 roles now have a default layout on all nine themed sites, pinned in presentation.test.ts and rendered at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000 with no overflow.
